supersedes: Earlier full-window layout concepts; this revision shows only plugin-owned narrow sidebar content.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Primary request: Correct an overbroad design mockup for Workspace Workbench, a PASEO PLUGIN usually opened in a NARROW RIGHT-HAND SIDEBAR. Produce one precise, high-fidelity concept image showing only the plugin's owned panel, never redesigning the PASEO host.
Reference image: use the supplied existing Workbench screenshot ONLY for its charcoal colors, subdued thin borders, compact typography and light-blue accent. It is not an edit target. Do not copy any of its host chrome.
Composition: a landscape presentation with TWO narrow portrait plugin panels SIDE BY SIDE, each representing an actual 360-pixel-wide sidebar at realistic 100% UI density, enlarged evenly for legibility. Both panels are states of the SAME layout, not sidebars within an app. No PASEO window, no native session list, no host navigation rail, no chat, no title-row colored dots outside the panel, no browser chrome, no desktop device mockup. The whole generated image should be approximately 1100 x 1250 proportions if possible, with generous margin and a small explanatory header.
Header above both panels exact text "窄侧栏设置 · 修正版"; subtitle "仅插件页面 · 单列布局 · 分类按需展开". Above the left panel exact caption "① 日常编辑"; above right exact caption "② 点击分类后".
UI style: realistic restrained engineering-tool interface, charcoal #15181b, cards #1c2025, borders #323840, off-white #d5d9df, accent #65b8f5. Crisp, correct Simplified Chinese text, readable approximately 13-14 logical pixel body text in a 360px-wide panel, 16px section headings, tight but comfortable spacing, 12px side padding. Do not use a wide two-column form. No permanent left category menu. No huge headings, neon glows, charts, fake statistics, marketing graphics, or watermark.
Both panels have the same plugin-owned top header "Workspace Workbench". Below a compact full-width project dropdown "项目：workspace-workbench" with chevron. Below a compact horizontally scrollable row of feature tabs "工作区" "文件" "话题" "缓存" "设置", with "设置" active blue underline. Everything inside this panel belongs to the plugin.
Left panel:
A simple settings heading "设置", and inline scope dropdown labelled "编辑范围" with selected "当前项目".
Then a FULL-WIDTH category selection button "标题与自动整理" with down chevron. This button replaces the permanent left sidebar. A small caption "当前项目覆盖 · 恢复继承".
All following cards are SINGLE COLUMN stacked vertically:
1. "自动维护标题" with an ON toggle at far right of the same row; beneath a muted short hint "根据关联 Workspace 持续整理".
2. "处理范围" collapsible card, summary "仅维护选中的会话" and a chevron.
3. "整理模型" expanded card. A full-width model dropdown "本机模型", small green "连接正常" text, and an outlined "测试连接" button. Under it a muted blue text link "配置模型连接". No invented exact model name or secret.
4. "整理规范" collapsible card; summary "中文 · 16 字 · 主旨＋状态". Below a compact toggle row "保留人工标题" ON.
5. "标题预览" expanded card. Exact sample text "🟡 登录异常修复" (the yellow circle is an emoji IN A TEXT PREVIEW, NOT an added host icon). Under it exact text "部分上线 · 关联 3 个 Workspace"; next line "尚余 1 项待上线". The preview remains entirely inside the plugin.
6. A slim secondary action row with history icon and text "历史整理".
Bottom sticky footer with two buttons side by side "预览结果" and primary blue "保存设置". A subtle scrollbar indicates vertical scrolling.
Right panel:
Repeat the same panel header and compact top tabs/context, with the same category selection button "标题与自动整理". Its down chevron is now open.
Show an IN-PANEL category selection popover immediately BELOW this button, confined completely within the 360px plugin panel boundaries, not a permanent column, not a page outside the panel. It is a single vertically scrolling list with top heading "选择设置分类", search field "搜索分类", a small close X. Exact list labels: "常用与显示", "项目与仓库", "会话与执行", "代码评审", "自动恢复", "环境与工具链", "缓存与存储", "文件与改动", "话题与资料", "生产与上线", "标题与自动整理", "状态与诊断". Highlight "标题与自动整理" in blue and add a checkmark. Rows have compact line icons. A thin scrollbar if needed. The underlying same single-column form may show partially below the popover, but do not put a second category navigation beside it.
Critical constraints: the user objects to redesigning PASEO and to losing narrow sidebar space. This image MUST show only feasible plugin content, narrow width, on-demand category selector, stacked settings. Neither portrait panel is a mobile phone; both are narrow DESKTOP PLUGIN SIDEBAR CONTENT. Keep long text naturally wrapped inside the panels.
